name: Four Seasons Paris, George V
insider_take: Palace-level luxury meets Parisian sophistication just steps from the Champs-Élysées, where every detail whispers elegance.
whats_special: This Art Deco masterpiece houses the only hotel in the world with three Michelin-starred restaurants under one roof. The breathtaking flower arrangements by Jeff Leatham transform the marble lobby into a living garden, using over 12,000 fresh blooms weekly. Each suite offers postcard views of either the Eiffel Tower or the golden dome of Les Invalides.
pro_tip: Book the Penthouse Suite for exclusive access to a private rooftop terrace with 360-degree views of Paris, including direct sightlines to both the Arc de Triomphe and Sacré-Cœur.
dont_miss: The legendary Le Spa treatment rooms feature original 18th-century stonework, while the hotel's sommelier offers private tastings from their 50,000-bottle wine cellar. Take the short stroll to Triangle d'Or for world-class shopping on Avenue Montaigne, or explore the nearby Grand Palais exhibitions.
pros: Prime location steps from Champs-Élysées and luxury shopping
Michelin-starred dining including Le Cinq restaurant
Legendary Four Seasons service and attention to detail
Elegant palatial architecture and opulent interiors
cons: Formal atmosphere may not suit all travelers
